title: TD-Pipe: Temporally-Disaggregated Pipeline Parallelism Architecture for High-Throughput LLM Inference

optimized_metrics.evidence: TD-Pipe effectively increases the throughput of LLM inference by up to 1.91

headline_claim.text: TD-Pipe effectively increases the throughput of LLM inference by up to 1.91 × over the existing tensor parallel approach and 2.73 × over the existing pipeline parallel approach
